Hair-growth OEM projects: decide the regulatory route before the label

AURVONX · 14 September 2026

A hair-growth or hair-loss brief must begin with the intended country and exact claims. These determine a pathway that cannot be solved by changing the product name alone.

Choose the right product formats

This is a three-format project portfolio for feasibility discussions: leave-on serum, shampoo and scalp treatment. It is not a retail kit or a ready-to-order therapeutic range.

Understand the ingredients

The FDA classification source explains why intended-use claims matter. A cosmetic ingredient list does not automatically permit a claim to regrow hair in the US.
